olivia: Scheduling blue/green swap for 'model-router' to v2026-03-21b. Change window 03:15 UTC -> updated to 03:30 UTC after infra check. Roll plan: 15% (2m) -> 50% (6m) -> 100% (4m). Owners @raj @sasha. Kicking in 10m unless objections. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: scheduled swap swivel-20260321 created by olivia. Start at 1717328356 (03:30 UTC). Roll steps: 15,50,100. Health probes=live/ready + rollback_on err_rate>1.5% or p95>400ms for 5m. Will post step updates.

raj: Hold — infra has noisy node maintenance at 03:10-03:20 in eu-west1. Can we shift 15 min later? :thinking:

olivia: Good catch. Move to 03:30 UTC. Updated schedule.

sasha: Confirmed we pinned model artifact sha=7f2a9d. Fallback route set to v2026-03-18 (stable). Canary eval set: smoke prompt 'hello' -> baseline p95 210ms.

kevin: Adding pre-flight smoke: curl -XPOST https://api.redwood-internal/route/predict -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'x-model: v2026-03-21b' ; expect 200 and p95 < 250ms.

deploy-bot: starting swap now — step 1 -> 15% (2m). routing change applied to router group A.

deploy-bot: progress update — at 15%: no errors, p50=120ms p95=190ms, ~2k rps.

sasha: running eval harness now. :eyes:

deploy-bot: stepping to 50% (6m).

network-bot: alert: brief 502 spike in eu-west1 at t+90s (rate 0.9% over baseline) — checking upstream.

kevin: pausing roll. @deploy-bot pause.

deploy-bot: roll paused at 50% step. Traffic allocation locked (stays at 15% until resume). Pause confirmed.

raj: I'll check router pods — router-3 in eu-west1 is in restart-loop. Restarting the pod now.

olivia: keep paused until stable, do NOT promote to 100.

network-bot: router-3 restarted, health=ok.

sasha: smoke tests green. p95 now 200ms, errors back to baseline 0.2%.

kevin: resume when comfortable. @deploy-bot resume.

deploy-bot: resuming — completing 50% -> 100% (final step). Rolling now.

deploy-bot: swap complete. final allocations: new=100% old=0%. Canary metrics: p95=205ms error=0.25% throughput stable.

olivia: Release notes: v2026-03-21b deployed. No rollback required. Documenting transient 502 during 50% ramp caused by router-3 restart. Action items: add pre-launch router pod health check & eviction protection (owner: raj), tune alert thresholds for brief spikes (owner: sasha).

raj: Will open infra PR for eviction protection and add improved readiness probe.

kevin: Nice coordination everyone. :tada:

olivia: Closing thread. If any customer regressions surface, ping on-call and revert to v2026-03-18.
